name: P_PERMITTED_IN_THIS_BAY_DURING_CLEARWAY_PERIOD_GREEN_TALL
legend: P PERMITTED IN THIS BAY DURING CLEARWAY PERIOD (right arrow)
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. R5-SA163 225 x 300 (2015, 1:5), R25, green on white, no border. P 100 E, 15 from the top, 78 / 81 / 66. Five lines 20 D, baselines 145 (30 below the P) / 170 / 195 / 220 / 245 (25 pitch): PERMITTED 134 (45/134/46), IN 22 + 15 + THIS 54 + 15 + BAY 51 (34 margins), DURING 93 (66/93/66), CLEARWAY 137 (44/137/44), PERIOD 89 (68/89/68). Arrow centre line 26 below the last baseline (y 271), 29 from the bottom. Arrows are the AS 1743 R5-14 (double, 155 x 32) and R5-16 (single, 125 x 32) open-chevron arrows the sheet cites, drawn as polygons with the national dimensions (shaft 12, head 42 long x 32 wide, barbs 12 thick). This spec is the sheet's right-arrow alternative (R5-16, 125 long, centred); the sheet draws the double arrow.
